summary: Develop defensible HR investigation skills through casework, interviews, evidence review, and reporting. Explore the course and build practical capability.
lede: Compliance investigation training for HR professionals covers structured responses to workplace allegations, from scoping cases to documenting findings. It is designed for employee-relations investigators, HR business partners, compliance officers, and in-house counsel who handle or oversee cases, with practice in allegation mapping, evidence preservation, witness interviews, credibility assessment, and linking evidence to policy in a documented findings report.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who investigate workplace allegations, advise decision-makers, or oversee HR case governance. It suits intermediate to advanced practitioners who can work with confidential employee information and want a more consistent investigation method.
audience: Line Managers assigned formal workplace investigations under
prerequisites: Prior experience in HR, employee relations, compliance, internal audit, investigations, or employment-law support is expected. You should be able to handle confidential workplace information and read organizational policies. No coding or programming is required. The course addresses internationally applicable investigation principles and does not replace jurisdiction-specific legal advice.
